examples.en: I have been all over the world hunting hurricanes.
examples.zh: 我在世界各地追寻飓风。

examples.en: In 2008, Cuba was hit by five successive hurricanes, but only seven people were killed.
examples.zh: 2008年，古巴连续遭受了五次飓风袭击，但只有七人死亡。

examples.en: At the same time, extreme weather events like Category 5 hurricanes are becoming more frequent.
examples.zh: 与此同时，5级飓风等极端气象事件出现得越来越频繁。
